items.prompt: An official printed government form with many small checkboxes and dense lines, clipped to a clipboard on a kindergarten table, too small to read; beside it lies a child's crayon drawing of a house with thin bright threads rising from its roof into the sky.

alt.ru: Официальный бланк с множеством мелких клеточек на планшете на столе детского сада; рядом детский рисунок мелками: дом, от крыши в небо поднимаются тонкие яркие нити.
alt.en: An official form with many small checkboxes on a clipboard on a kindergarten table; beside it a child's crayon drawing of a house with thin bright threads rising from its roof.
alt.pt: Um formulário oficial com muitas quadrículas numa prancheta numa mesa de jardim de infância; ao lado um desenho a lápis de cera de uma casa com fios brilhantes a subir do telhado.
alt.es: Un formulario oficial con muchas casillas en una carpeta sobre una mesa de guardería; al lado un dibujo infantil a ceras de una casa con hilos brillantes que suben del tejado.
